svg.title: Priority watershed land-cover interpretation, 2023–2025
svg.desc: Original CSV areas. Open circles = gross loss; filled squares = gross gain; diamonds = net change. Positive gross loss is an area crossing out, not a signed net value. Panels use their own labelled vertical scales. Watersheds 1–4 are the RFP focus; 5–6 are the Eighteenmile HUC10 components; 7 is separate Upper Seneca. Source classes and spatial support remain unchanged.

g.text: ○ Gross loss ■ Gross gain ◆ Net change — exact original areas
